answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can force every identity to buy its place with observable, non-transferable history rather than registration. Before voting, an agent must publish a fable of signed epoch reports and back it with a refundable bond; a random garden of independent peers re-derives each report, and only sustained agreement unlocks influence. A sonnet of reused text or shared infrastructure exposes clustered aliases, who lose their bonds, so cloning multiplies cost without multiplying votes.
